issue.standard_remedy: Consolidate tail suppliers into preferred suppliers
issue.summary: 143 of 177 suppliers share the last 20% of category spend

plan.diagnosis: Plastic resins category exhibits severe supplier fragmentation with 143 tail suppliers accounting for USD 1,832,264 (20% of the USD 9,318,219 category spend), while the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of 1,279 confirms weak concentration. This fragmentation creates unnecessary administrative overhead, limits volume leverage, and prevents economies of scale despite Delta Metals KG holding 31.6% share as the clear market leader.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct tail supplier spend analysis across all ERPs (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa) to identify the 143 suppliers and rank by spend, quality, and strategic fit; shortlist 5-8 preferred suppliers capable of absorbing tail volume
Issue RFP to shortlisted suppliers (including Delta Metals KG) for consolidated volume of USD 1,832,264, targeting 12-18% price reduction and standardized payment terms (Net 60)
Award contracts to 3-4 preferred suppliers, negotiate master service agreements with volume commitments, and establish quarterly business reviews

Implement ERP controls: block 143 tail suppliers across all systems, create approved source lists for plastic resins restricted to preferred suppliers, and update purchase requisition workflows with category compliance checks
Communicate supplier consolidation to all requisitioners, provide training on new sourcing requirements, and establish exception approval process through Category Manager
Monitor compliance and savings realization monthly; track maverick spend and preferred supplier performance against KPIs

plan.expected_impact: Consolidation of USD 1,832,264 tail spend into 3-4 preferred suppliers will generate annual savings of USD 219,872 to USD 329,808 (12-18% reduction target) plus administrative cost avoidance from reducing supplier base by 80%.
kpis: Supplier count reduction: from 177 to 34 or fewer (80% reduction in tail suppliers)
Category HHI improvement: target increase from 1,279 to 2,000+
Tail spend savings realization: USD 219,872 minimum (12% of USD 1,832,264)
Maverick spend rate: <5% of plastic resins category spend
Preferred supplier fill rate: >95% within 6 months
risks: Incumbent tail suppliers may service niche requirements or regional plants that preferred suppliers cannot fulfil
Volume concentration with fewer suppliers increases supply continuity risk if preferred supplier fails
Multi-ERP environment may create enforcement gaps if blocking controls are not synchronized across all five systems
Requisitioner resistance to change may drive workarounds and shadow purchasing outside approved channels
Preferred suppliers may lack capacity or willingness to absorb fragmented tail volume at attractive pricing
erp_actions: SAP: Set posting block in LFA1 (central) and LFB1 (company code level) for all 143 tail suppliers; update purchasing organization data with deletion flag
SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for plastic resins material group restricted to 3-4 preferred suppliers with validity dates; activate source list requirement in material master (MAT_PLANNERS)
Oracle EBS: Set supplier status to 'Inactive' for tail suppliers in PO module; create approved supplier list (ASL) for plastic resins category with preferred suppliers only
Dynamics 365: Update vendor records to 'On hold' status for purchasing transactions; configure purchasing policies to enforce approved vendor list for plastic resins procurement category
NetSuite: Set vendor status to 'Inactive' for tail suppliers; create item-level preferred vendor assignments for plastic resin items restricted to preferred suppliers
Coupa: Remove tail suppliers from commodity 'Plastic resins' and set catalog visibility to 'Private'; add preferred suppliers to guided buying workflows with contract price visibility

All ERPs: Update payment terms to Net 60 for preferred plastic resins suppliers to standardize cash flow management; configure three-way match requirements (PO-Receipt-Invoice) for all plastic resins purchases
